Overview

Azure Front Door powers application delivery, acceleration, security, load management, and Internet routing for Microsoft, LinkedIn, Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, and thousands of customers worldwide. The service operates one of the largest edge networks in the industry, processing massive amounts of traffic across a globally distributed fleet. The existing AFD Senior Engineer template emphasizes building globally distributed, scalable, low-latency services that power critical Microsoft and Azure workloads.
